body.statement:
There is a universal \(\alpha<\infty\) such that, whenever
\(1\le d_n\le n^{2/3}\) and \(n\) is sufficiently large,
\[
\Pr_{G_n}\!\left\{\lambda_{\star}(A_{G_n})
\le\alpha\sqrt{d_n}\right\}\ge1-n^{-2}.
\]

attestation.note: The theorem statement and its uniform-simple-regular scope were checked directly against Theorem 1.1 of arXiv:1510.06013; the stable DOI and exact locator are supplied in lieu of a verbatim transcription.
